Ack.description:
A void result. JSON-RPC allows a null result, but an object leaves room to
add a field later without changing the shape a client already parses.

token.description:
Required on TCP. Omitted on a Unix socket, where the socket's own
permissions already prove the caller is this user.

username.description: The Soulseek account the daemon is logged in as.

BrowseEvent.description:
A peer answered a browse request. Carried whole rather than as a "go ask
for it" nudge, because the daemon's own copy is consumed when it drains.

ChatMessageDto.description:
One line of chat history. Unlike a live [`UserMessageDto`] this carries a
direction, because a conversation the daemon collected includes what this
account sent as well as what it received.

peer.description: The other party, whichever way the message went.

DaemonStatus.description: What the daemon is and what its session is doing, from `daemon.status`.

DirectoryParams.description:
Where the daemon should land transfers from now on, on *its* filesystem.
The same trust as `shares.set`: an authenticated caller is the owner.

DownloadStatusEvent.description: One step in a transfer this client started.

attribs.description: Soulseek attribute codes (0 = bitrate, 1 = duration in seconds).

SearchSummary.description: One search as the daemon sees it, for a client that did not run it.

files.description: Files found so far, across every peer that has answered.

started_secs_ago.description:
How long ago the query went out. A client compares this with its own
search window to decide whether the search is still collecting.

Searches.description:
Every search this session has run, newest last. Shared by all clients, so
a second one attaching sees what the first has been looking for.

files.description: Basename and size; join with the directory to get a downloadable path.

SharesStatus.description: What the share index holds, from `shares.status` / `shares.reindex`.

TransferRef.description: Names one transfer, which is how both directions are addressed.

oneOf.description: Waiting for a slot, at this 1-based place in the queue.

UserInfoDto.description:
Each half is `None` until its reply lands, so a consumer can tell "the
server said offline" from "the server has not answered yet".

Watched.description: Everyone this session is watching, sorted by name.

info.description: Control a running soulseek-rs daemon. Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over a Unix socket (local, authenticated by socket permissions) or TCP (remote, authenticated by the token in <state-dir>/daemon.token). `auth` must be the first request on a connection. Errors carry the CLI exit status in `error.data.exit`. Entries marked `x-notification` are pushed by the daemon and are never requested.
info.title: soulseek-rs daemon

methods.name: auth

schema.description:
Required on TCP. Omitted on a Unix socket, where the socket's own
permissions already prove the caller is this user.

methods.summary: Authenticate. Must be the first request on a connection.

methods.name: daemon.status

methods.name: daemon.stop
methods.summary: Ask the daemon to shut down.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: This document.

methods.summary: Put a search on the wire and return at once; results accumulate.

methods.name: search.results
methods.summary: Everything that has answered a search so far.

methods.name: search.list
methods.summary: Every search this session has run, shared by all clients.

methods.summary: Send a query as a wishlist search (server code 103).

methods.name: search.wishlist_interval
methods.summary: How long the server wants between wishlist searches.

methods.summary: Resume a paused transfer.

methods.summary: Forget a transfer entirely.

methods.name: download.remove_queued
